posts.title: Next Pandemic we should have Challenge Trials
posts.description: Covid-19 is long enough away now that we should look at what happened and decide what we want to to next time there is a pandemic. One thing we could do is challenge trials of vaccines. This would have sped up vaccine deployment hugely and saved time and huge amounts of money. posts.title: Ireland goes majority Solar May 24th 2026
posts.description: Green Collective solar farm only figure was a record % At 2:30 today, Ireland’s solar share may have been about 51% of total electricity demand , once imports and domestic rooftop solar are included. Calculation: Solar = grid solar + solar imports + domestic solar = 1.16 + 0.41 + 0.58 = 2.15 GW Demand = grid demand + domestic solar = 3.66 + 0.58 = 4.24 GW Solar share = 2.15 / 4.24 = 50.7% Domestic
